en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Haroun Bin Muslim, from Mas’ada Bin Ziyad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The fruits are of one hundred and twenty types, the chief of these being the Pomegranate’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his Harun ibn Muslim from Mas’adah ibn Ziyad who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Fruits are of one hundred twenty colors and the pomegranate is its master.’”
